apps.localizedDescription:
Hopp is a podcast player for every podcast, built for Podcasting 2.0: chapters, transcripts, people, and value for value over Lightning.

No account, no tracking. Install it and listen. Hopp collects nothing and runs no server of its own. A privacy page explains in plain words who sees what when you listen — and what you can do about it.

Only your wallet. Hopp has no built-in wallet and never holds your sats. Connect your own Lightning wallet over Nostr Wallet Connect (NWC), boost an episode or a whole show, or stream sats while you listen — within a daily budget you set.

100 % to the podcasters. Hopp takes no cut; routing fees are shown separately.

Sovereigncast shows come alive in Hopp: Release Boosting, Boost2Unlock, topic votes and the community's top boosts.

Hopp is open source (MIT).
